EmailTemplate.description: Sent to a channel partner when its access extension is rejected (Partner Portal Setting: Extension Rejected Email Template).
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Access Extension Rejected
EmailTemplate.subject: Your John Keells Properties Partner Portal access extension
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.Name},
Your request to extend the Partner Portal access of {!Account.Name} was not approved.
QUESTIONS? If you have any questions, please contact the JKP CP team.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
